text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize a speed limit reduction from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Woburn Avenue, between Bathurst Street and Ledbury Street. The technical criteria to warrant a 30 km/h maximum speed limit on Woburn Avenue is satisfied, based on the parkland abutting the road that is used to gain access to a school.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Woburn Avenue, between Bathurst Street and Ledbury Street.
